narrative:
Short impact summary

Taking Stock of Industrial Ecology (2016), published by Springer Nature, has been cited 476 times — enough that OpenAlex puts it in the top 1% of works in its field and year. Beyond that, it has been downloaded 19,759 times.

Full narrative

Taking Stock of Industrial Ecology by Roland Clift and Angela Druckman was published by Springer Nature in 2016. Conceptually, the work connects to Industrial ecology, Stock (firearms), Ecology, Business and Environmental resource management.

OpenAlex records 476 citations. That places it in the top 1% of works in its field and year of publication. Citations peaked in 2018 with 97 citing works. Notable citing venues include Journal of Cleaner Production, Cambridge University Press eBooks and Sustainability. The citing works include 339 journal articles, 90 book chapters and 12 reviews. They come from 40 countries, led by the United Kingdom, the United States and Germany.

It has been downloaded 19,759 times via OAPEN. Open Library reports a combined count of 3 reading logs and catalog editions.
